clue.text: Piece of music from show, Oscar's first

parts.note: a concert is a musical show or performance

indicators.note: the first letter of the word Oscar's is taken

parts.note: first letter of Oscar's

explanation.surface: A piece of music is drawn from a show, with Oscar's winning first.
explanation.walkthrough: Oscar is also the NATO alphabet word for O, but here the first letter of the word does the same job.
explanation.definitionFit: A concerto is a musical composition for a solo instrument and orchestra.

indicators.note: almost means not quite all, so the word for round loses its final letter

parts.note: plump means rounded or chubby

explanation.surface: A fruit that is nearly spherical and purple in colour.
explanation.definitionFit: Plums are the familiar stone fruit with dark purple skin.

clue.text: Band's kit on edge of stage

parts.note: a football team's kit is its strip, the outfit it plays in

indicators.note: the edge here is the final letter of the word stage, its end

parts.note: last letter of stage

explanation.surface: A band's equipment is set up at the front edge of the stage.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Band' suggests musicians, and 'kit' a drum kit, but the band is a strip of colour. In a down clue 'on' puts STRIP above E.
explanation.definitionFit: A stripe is a long narrow band of colour on a surface.

clue.text: Level pegging on board in game

indicators.note: on, as in on board a vessel, means the even scores are placed within the ship letters

parts.note: to board is to go aboard a ship, and SS is the steamship abbreviation
level pegging means scores are even

explanation.surface: Scores are level on the board during a game.
explanation.walkthrough: 'On board' is the crossword convention for going inside SS, the steamship abbreviation. Sevens is seven-a-side rugby.
explanation.definitionFit: Sevens is a form of rugby played with seven players a side, a sport in its own right.

indicators.note: something damaged is broken up, so the letters of radio set are rearranged

explanation.surface: A space traveller's radio set has been damaged on the journey.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Space traveller' suggests an astronaut, but it is a rock orbiting the sun.
explanation.definitionFit: An asteroid is a small rocky body travelling through space around the sun.

indicators.note: losing its heart means the middle letter of the game's name drops out

parts.note: rugby is a ball game

explanation.surface: A girl playing a game becomes discouraged.
explanation.definitionFit: Ruby is a female first name, so it stands for a girl.

indicators.note: holding means containing, so one word wraps round the other

parts.note: a route is a course taken
let means allow or permit

explanation.surface: A golf course holds a licence for gambling games.
explanation.definitionFit: Roulette is the casino gambling game with a spinning wheel and ball.

parts.note: S is the abbreviation for small, as in clothing sizes
a hut is a small cabin

explanation.surface: A small cabin is shut up for the season.
explanation.definitionFit: To shut something is to close it, a straightforward verb synonym.

indicators.note: after puts the later pieces behind the letter for seconds

parts.note: camp means affected or exaggerated in manner
I is the Roman numeral for one

explanation.surface: Someone affected by eating seafood goes back for second helpings.
explanation.definitionFit: Scampi are breaded langoustine tails, a popular seafood dish.

parts.note: a leg is a stage of a journey

indicators.note: the end of the word Journey's is its last letter

parts.note: the word Journey, whose last letter is taken

explanation.surface: A poem from the English stage, the play Journey's End.
explanation.walkthrough: Journey's End is a famous English First World War play, which makes 'stage' read as theatre rather than a leg of a trip.
explanation.definitionFit: An elegy is a mournful poem, typically a lament for the dead.

parts.note: P is the chess notation for pawn
in means fashionable, as in 'the in thing'

explanation.surface: Someone pawns a fashionable brooch.
explanation.definitionFit: A pin is a decorative brooch fastened with a pin, a common jewellery sense.

parts.note: a range is a large cooking stove

explanation.surface: There is a good big stove in the farmhouse kitchen.
explanation.walkthrough: A range is a large cast-iron kitchen stove, such as an Aga.
explanation.definitionFit: A grange is a country house with farm buildings attached.

clue.text: Novice in religious order, one they ordered to keep quiet

indicators.note: to keep means to hold inside, so the shuffled letters surround the letter for quiet
ordered means put into a new arrangement, so the letters of one they are shuffled

parts.note: P is the musical abbreviation for piano, quiet

explanation.surface: A novice in a monastery is one they ordered to keep silent.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Ordered' looks like it echoes 'religious order' but it is the anagram signal on ONE THEY.
explanation.definitionFit: A neophyte is a newcomer, specifically a newly admitted member of a religious community.

clue.text: Wife, maybe, requires support, heading off

indicators.note: heading off means the word's first letter is removed

parts.note: to espouse a cause is to support it

explanation.surface: A wife requires support, so she heads off.
explanation.definitionFit: A wife is one example of a spouse, a married partner, hence the 'maybe'.

indicators.note: outside means one word goes round the other

parts.note: a nun is called Sister
in means at home

explanation.surface: A menacing nun lurks outside someone's house.
explanation.definitionFit: Sinister means ominous or suggesting harm, so threatening.

clue.text: Record label millions love, tenor's first to admit

parts.note: M is the abbreviation for million
love is zero in tennis, the letter O

indicators.note: the first letter of the word tenor's is taken

parts.note: first letter of tenor
to own up is to admit

explanation.surface: Millions love a record label, and the tenor is the first to admit it.
explanation.definitionFit: Motown is the famous Detroit record company behind soul acts like the Supremes.

parts.note: an arrow points the way

explanation.surface: A strict teacher with a new pointer.
explanation.definitionFit: Narrow can mean rigid or limited in interpretation, as in a narrow reading of the rules.

indicators.note: across means the first pieces sit astride the letter for river

parts.note: a dent is a hollow in a surface

explanation.surface: A burning hollow stretches across the river.
explanation.definitionFit: Ardent means passionate or fervent, with literal roots in burning heat.

indicators.note: moving means changing position, so the letters of statue are rearranged

explanation.surface: A shrewd sense of a statue that seems to move.
explanation.definitionFit: Astute means sharp-witted and perceptive, a close synonym of shrewd.

indicators.note: in means the letters sit inside the words Christmas setting, spanning both

explanation.surface: A donkey in a Christmas nativity scene.
explanation.definitionFit: An ass is another name for a donkey, a familiar figure in the nativity story.

clue.text: That woman behind us is a theatre attendant

indicators.note: behind means the woman comes after the word us

parts.note: taken as written
her refers to that woman

explanation.surface: That woman sitting behind us is staff in the theatre.
explanation.definitionFit: An usher shows people to their seats in a theatre or cinema.

parts.note: a do is a party or function

explanation.surface: A United Nations function is ruined.
explanation.definitionFit: To undo something is to reverse or destroy it, so to ruin it.

indicators.note: written about means placed around, so the rubbish surrounds the letter for husband

parts.note: trash means rubbish
H is the abbreviation for husband

explanation.surface: Rubbish is written about a husband's party.
explanation.walkthrough: In British slang a thrash is a lively party.
explanation.definitionFit: A thrash is informal British English for a wild party or celebration.

indicators.note: in a down clue over means placed above, so the letter for runs comes first

parts.note: R is the cricket abbreviation for runs
aid means help

explanation.surface: Someone runs over to help with an attack.
explanation.definitionFit: A raid is a sudden surprise attack on a place.

clue.text: Rework text of Nesbit, perhaps unfinished

indicators.note: unfinished means the last letter is removed

parts.note: E. Nesbit, author of The Railway Children, was Edith Nesbit; 'perhaps' shows she is one example of an Edith

explanation.surface: Someone reworks a text by Nesbit that was left unfinished.
explanation.walkthrough: E. Nesbit was the English children's author Edith Nesbit; 'perhaps' shows she is just one Edith.
explanation.definitionFit: To edit is to revise or correct written material.

clue.text: One thought unlikely to win, away team against second in group

parts.note: out means away, not at home
a side is a team

indicators.note: second in means the second letter of the word group

parts.note: second letter of group

explanation.surface: An away team playing against the second-placed side in its group is unlikely to win.
explanation.definitionFit: An outsider is a competitor given little chance of victory by the bookmakers.
